rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun when the exact type of diagram is clear from context.

example.english: This diagram clearly explains how the machine works.
example.traditional: 呢幅圖好清楚咁講解部機點樣運作。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 tou4 hou2 cing1 co2 gam2 gong2 gaai2 bou6 gei1 dim2 joeng2 wan6 zok3

rows.note: Use this for a schematic or explanatory drawing showing how parts relate or work.

example.english: Follow this diagram when assembling it, and you won’t connect the wires incorrectly.
example.traditional: 跟住呢張示意圖砌，就唔會駁錯條線。
example.jyutping: gan1 zyu6 ni1 zoeng1 si6 ji3 tou4 cai3 zau6 m4 wui5 bok3 co3 tiu4 sin3

rows.note: Use this for a graph or chart, especially one displaying data or change over time.

example.english: This diagram shows the sales figures for the past five years.
example.traditional: 呢個圖表顯示過去五年嘅銷售額。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tou4 biu2 hin2 si6 gwo3 heoi3 ng5 nin4 ge3 siu1 sau6 ngaak6
